_what: A browser session an AI drives through the person's signed-in browser, one call at a time (extension/src/browser-session.mjs, run as tool:drive-my-browser). The session owns an unfocused window of its own and only the tabs it opened; the person's own tabs are never listed, read or moved. A call is { session?, do, ... } where `do` is a row of `verbs`: tabs (list), open, close, navigate, back, forward, act (steps for the page engine in extension/page-actions.json, including snapshot and click by ref), read, lock, release, end. `data_class` on each verb is what it touches; `limits.deny_classes` lists classes the host refuses and is empty: nothing is refused by default, and a class named there is refused in the host whatever the AI asks. `lock` is the person taking the browser back: while a session is locked every verb that acts or navigates is refused, in words, until `release`; reads, tabs and end still answer.

tabs.what: List the tabs this session opened.

open.what: Open a page in a new tab of this session's window: url.

close.what: Close one of this session's tabs: tab.

navigate.what: Send a tab to another address: tab, url.

back.what: Go back in a tab: tab.

forward.what: Go forward in a tab: tab.

act.what: Do steps on the page in a tab (click, type, fill, press, scroll, drag, snapshot, select, hover, focus): tab, steps, dry_run?

read.what: Read the page in a tab as text and links: tab.

lock.what: The person takes the browser back: the session stops acting.

release.what: Hand the browser back to the session.

end.what: Close the session's window and forget it.

words.unknown_verb: This browser session has no verb named {verb}.
words.no_session: There is no session {session}; start one with open.
words.too_many_tabs: This session already has {max} tabs open.
words.bad_scheme: Only pages at {schemes} can be opened.
words.denied_class: The host refuses {class} actions in this browser.
words.locked: The person has taken over this browser. {verb} waits until it is released.
words.locked_now: The browser is locked: the person has it.
words.released: The browser is the session's again.
words.ended: The session ended and its window was closed.
words.slow: {url} did not finish loading within {seconds} seconds.
